consentText: I voluntarily donate this response record for publication in a research dataset and for research and commercial or non-commercial AI training, evaluation, fine-tuning, benchmarking, and related analysis. I understand that completing the questionnaire alone does not donate my data.
withdrawal: An implementation must explain whether and until when withdrawal is technically possible. After effective irreversible anonymisation or incorporation into a released aggregate or model, linkage and withdrawal may no longer be possible.
implementationRequirement: Do not activate collection without a named data controller, privacy notice, retention policy, security controls, and documented legal basis.
